text.KJV: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
text.ASV: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ;
text.WEB: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ:

text.KJV: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
text.ASV: We are bound to give thanks to God always to you, brethren, even as it is meet, for that your faith growth exceedingly, and the love of each one of you all toward one another aboundeth;
text.WEB: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you towards one another abounds;

text.KJV: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
text.ASV: so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which ye endure;
text.WEB: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

text.KJV: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
text.ASV: `which is' a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God; to the end that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
text.WEB: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

text.KJV: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
text.ASV: if so be that it is righteous thing with God to recompense affliction to them that afflict you,
text.WEB: Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

text.KJV: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
text.ASV: and to you that are afflicted rest with us, at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of his power in flaming fire,
text.WEB: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

text.KJV: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
text.ASV: rendering vengeance to them that know not God, and to them that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus:
text.WEB: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

text.KJV: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
text.ASV: who shall suffer punishment, `even' eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
text.WEB: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

text.KJV: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
text.ASV: when he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be marvelled at in all them that believed (because our testimony unto you was believed) in that day.
text.WEB: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

text.KJV: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
text.ASV: To which end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfil every desire of goodness and `every' work of faith, with power;
text.WEB: To this end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith, with power;

text.KJV: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
text.ASV: Now we beseech you, brethren, touching the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together unto him;
text.WEB: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together to him, we ask you

text.KJV: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
text.ASV: to the end that ye be not quickly shaken from your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by epistle as from us, as that the day of the Lord is just at hand;
text.WEB: not to be quickly shaken in your mind, and not be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

text.KJV: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
text.ASV: let no man beguile you in any wise: for `it will not be,' except the falling away come first, and the man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition,
text.WEB: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction,

text.KJV: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
text.ASV: he that opposeth and exalteth himself against all that is called God or that is worshipped; so that he sitteth in the temple of God, setting himself forth as God.
text.WEB: he who opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped; so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

text.KJV: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
text.ASV: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
text.WEB: Don’t you remember that, when I was still with you, I told you these things?

text.KJV: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
text.ASV: And now ye know that which restraineth, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
text.WEB: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

text.KJV: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
text.ASV: For the mystery of lawlessness doth already work: only `there is' one that restraineth now, until he be taken out of the way.
text.WEB: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

text.KJV: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
text.ASV: And then shall be revealed the lawless one, whom the Lord Jesus shall slay with the breath of his mouth, and bring to nought by the manifestation of his coming;
text.WEB: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth, and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

text.KJV: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
text.ASV: `even he', whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
text.WEB: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

text.KJV: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
text.ASV: and with all deceit of unrighteousness for them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
text.WEB: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

text.KJV: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
text.ASV: And for this cause God sendeth them a working of error, that they should believe a lie:
text.WEB: Because of this, God sends them a working of error, that they should believe a lie;

text.KJV: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
text.ASV: that they all might be judged who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
text.WEB: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

text.KJV: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
text.ASV: But we are bound to give thanks to God always for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, for that God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
text.WEB: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth;

text.KJV: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: whereunto he called you through our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
text.ASV: So then, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye were taught, whether by word, or by epistle of ours.
text.WEB: So then, brothers, stand firm, and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word, or by letter.

text.KJV: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
text.ASV: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
text.WEB: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

text.KJV: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
text.ASV: comfort your hearts and establish them in every good work and word.
text.WEB: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

text.KJV: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
text.ASV: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, even as also `it is' with you;
text.WEB: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you;

text.KJV: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
text.ASV: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for all have not faith.
text.WEB: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

text.KJV: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
text.ASV: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and guard you from the evil `one'.
text.WEB: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.

text.KJV: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
text.ASV: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command.
text.WEB: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

text.KJV: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
text.ASV: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.
text.WEB: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love, and into the perseverance of Christ.

text.KJV: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
text.ASV: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which they received of us.
text.WEB: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion, and not after the tradition which they received from us.

text.KJV: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
text.ASV: For yourselves know how ye ought to imitate us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
text.WEB: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

text.KJV: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
text.ASV: neither did we eat bread for nought at any man's hand, but in labor and travail, working night and day, that we might not burden any of you:
text.WEB: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you;

text.KJV: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
text.ASV: not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves and ensample unto you, that ye should imitate us.
text.WEB: not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

text.KJV: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
text.ASV: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, If any will not work, neither let him eat.
text.WEB: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone will not work, don’t let him eat.”

text.KJV: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
text.ASV: For we hear of some that walk among you disorderly, that work not at all, but are busybodies.
text.WEB: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

text.KJV: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
text.ASV: Now them that are such we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
text.WEB: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

text.KJV: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
text.ASV: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well-doing.
text.WEB: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

text.KJV: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
text.ASV: And if any man obeyeth not our word by this epistle, note that man, that ye have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
text.WEB: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

text.KJV: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
text.ASV: And `yet' count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
text.WEB: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

text.KJV: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
text.ASV: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
text.WEB: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

text.KJV: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
text.ASV: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
text.WEB: The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter: this is how I write.

text.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
text.ASV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
text.WEB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
